description: This file defines React components for a customizable select dropdown UI, leveraging radix-ui primitives and lucide icons. It provides components such as Select, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem, and related helper components for building a styled dropdown menu.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Main component wrapping radix select root element, passing through props.

methods.name: SelectGroup
methods.description: Provides grouping for select items, wrapping radix group component.

methods.name: SelectValue
methods.description: Displays selected value within the select component.

methods.name: SelectTrigger
methods.description: Clickable element that triggers the dropdown to open, styled with different sizes.

methods.name: SelectContent
methods.description: Contains the dropdown menu items with animation and positioning logic.

methods.name: SelectLabel
methods.description: Optional label for grouping items inside the select.

methods.name: SelectItem
methods.description: Represents a selectable item within the dropdown.

methods.name: SelectSeparator
methods.description: Visual separator line between groups of items.

methods.name: SelectScrollUpButton
methods.description: Button to scroll up within the dropdown list.

methods.name: SelectScrollDownButton
methods.description: Button to scroll down within the dropdown list.
